claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + magic_item UnitRecord kind
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: No magic_item kind exists in UnitRecord. types.ts only defines SpellRecord, ClassFeatureRecord, and MasteryRecord. The v4 taxonomy lists magic_item_root as a source atom and attune as a procedure atom, but the schema layer never wired them into a UnitRecord variant. Every magic item hits this wall before any atom-level question arises.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Armor (Chain Mail or Chain Shirt), Rare — the item category itself has no surface home

claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_property mechanics family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Elven Chain's +1 AC and proficiency grant are always-on while worn — no activation cost, no use-count, no spell slot. The existing families (activation for class features, on_hit_trigger for masteries, spell families for spells) all require an action or trigger. Magic items with static worn effects need a passive_property or worn_property family that emits a persist-like lifecycle rooted on the item.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class while you wear this armor.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_proficiency as a surface effect type
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: grant_proficiency exists in v4 taxonomy (§9 Effect Atoms) but is not exposed in types.ts as any Effect or ClassFeatureEffect variant. Elven Chain's training override — 'considered trained with this armor even if you lack training' — requires it. This would be a surface_widening relative to the class-feature effect union, but it only becomes relevant once MagicItemRecord exists.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You are considered trained with this armor even if you lack training with Medium or Heavy armor.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_ac as a standalone passive effect (not just ReactionEffect)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: modify_ac appears in types.ts only as a ReactionEffect (Shield-style: fires once, during a triggered reaction window). Elven Chain's +1 AC is a persistent addend while worn — not reaction-gated. A passive modify_ac variant (or a worn_property effect shape) is needed to represent it honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class while you wear this armor.
